title: Root canonicalization and GA4 delivery are defective
description: The static Astro root exposes a visible meta-refresh page and conflicting sitemap signal; language negotiation is absent. Separately, the GA4 wrapper does not emit collection requests after consent. Proposed correction: Worker-first handling for root and www canonical redirects, exclude root from sitemap, use the official gtag arguments queue, and add HTTP plus analytics transport regression tests.
close_reason: Commit 50f731d was pushed and Cloudflare version 3a600c1c-7966-4155-9231-4310bff597a4 was verified in production: root redirects, sitemap signals and GA4 page_view transport all pass.
